findings.result: ODA §24.2.2.5 assigns unknown-property references to the first table and schema references to the second. The new generated ODA §24.3 schema-only test reproduced the local reader's reversed mapping; implementation is recorded in the companion local fast-slice receipt.

The printed formula's plus-anchor expression conflicts with its coordinate definitions and parenthetical. Derivation from absolute coordinates yields segment.size - anchorBytes - recordLocalOffset; existing code's segmentEndOffset - recordOffset already implements it. No parser change is indicated.

ACadSharp PR discussion gives detailed but unpublished peer-reader failure coordinates. The peer author disputes validity of the stale entry. It does not establish a valid producer profile or a libdxfrw defect. Current local source consumes the header-selected index once and bounds it by a self-reference when available; it does not recursively parse every listed segidx segment.
findings.planOwner: Existing conditional PAR-07 / S8.3 edge; legality remains external/unresolved

findings.result: LibreDWG issue #695 is historical, closed, and labeled intentional illegal input/not repro; the report contains mixed failure traces. It is a parser-safety reminder, not current status, proof of an AcDs-specific defect, or evidence about libdxfrw.
